format_data: Fixed Baseline level31/CAVLC/QP26 VGA SPS/PPS/slice header data and controls verified against actual H264InitSPS/PPS/EncSliceHeader/h264EncFrame instructions. P header remainder uses the real six-bit command and ready precondition. Ring cursor derives from actual prior output; reconstruction and auxiliary buffers remain opaque.
host_only: Unicorn for isolated AArch64 reference/native instruction checks
pyelftools for actual ELF geometry and identities
FFmpeg for nonconstant VGA NV12 fixture production
qualification: Native instruction models inject entropy/completion only. Physical H264 arithmetic, reconstruction contents, bursts, visibility, completion timing and drain remain unqualified.
